wells-fargo-initiate-business-400.audit_note: Current primary and DoC September 10 update confirm November 10 expiration; legacy separate links are one campaign, not additive. Initiate is non-interest-bearing (disclosure p6); no effective APY date asserted. Latest funding day 30 through day 60 inclusive =31 days; first promotional withdrawal day 61, not permission to close. Five posted ACH deposits can qualify; Wells transfers, RTP/FedNow, Zelle, withdrawals and debit-card credits do not. Fee disclosure p4: initial periods ending within 64 days waived; periods last 25-35 days. Explicit no-relationship scenario: $25 days0-29, tier days30-60, retain $2,000 days61-90 through latest payout, withdraw/close only after confirmed payout. No monthly fee under that schedule; no optional fee-bearing transactions assumed. At 4% APY: promotional opportunity cost $8.34, opening/payout-reserve cost $6.54, modeled net $385.12 (Good ROI by >=$300 net). This scenario is separate from canonical gross 31-day ROI; exact actual net depends on posting/fee dates. Source: https://www.doctorofcredit.com/wells-fargo-400-825-business-checking-bonus/
